extracted.name: Bread Dipping Oil
extracted.description: Make this olive oil bread dip with simple ingredients including extra virgin olive oil, balsamic vinegar, and Parmigiano Reggiano for a crowd-pleasing appetizer that's ready in minutes. Pair it with a warm, crusty baguette for an effortless elegant starter for any meal!
ingredient_lines: 1 cup good quality extra virgin olive oil
¼ teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes
instruction_lines: Add olive oil, balsamic vinegar, garlic powder, oregano, crushed red pepper and flake salt to a bowl and stir to combine. Top with fresh grated parmesan. Serve with sliced baguette, for dipping.
categories: Balsamic vinegar and olive oil bread dip
